{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Sides

|descr= Determines if side B is friendly to side A the way the game engine does it. The relationship table can be found here:  [[Side Relations]].

|s1= [sideA, sideB] call [[BIS_fnc_sideIsFriendly]]

|p1= sideA: [[Side]]
|p2= sideB: [[Side]]

|r1= [[Boolean]] - true if side B is friendly to side A.

|x1= <sqf>private _isFriendly = [west, east] call BIS_fnc_sideIsFriendly; //Checks if EAST is friendly to WEST.</sqf>
